purpose: Create a minimum representative, solution-neutral scenario batch across the human-AI collaboration mother framework and the software-engineering lifecycle specialization without converting structural sampling into coverage completion.

basis.relationship: This batch extends domain and software-lifecycle sampling. The supplemental report is a candidate scenario and claim-ledger input only; it does not replace the existing context, Git, MCP, or Skill evidence lanes or prove lifecycle completeness.

coverageSemantics.hardRequirementRole: mandatory outcome and evidence gate independent of AI, model, Skill, Hook, or Agent
coverageSemantics.softCapabilityRole: upstream intervention candidate that may help pass a hard gate but cannot replace the gate, accountable owner, or proof
coverageSemantics.routeSelectionRule: compare the smallest applicable path in order and stop when sufficient; repository authoring remains ineligible until a repeated material residual gap is evidenced

hostClasses.description: Host exposes relevant state, approvals, or telemetry through a documented native surface.
hostClasses.claimLimit: Documented availability is not live task success.

hostClasses.description: Host exposes configurable instructions, Skills, tools, or adapters with host-specific precedence and lifecycle.
hostClasses.claimLimit: Configuration presence is not loading, adherence, or behavior proof.

hostClasses.description: Host behavior or telemetry is unavailable, incomplete, or not independently observable.
hostClasses.claimLimit: Use bounded heuristics and explicit unknowns; do not synthesize precision.

hostClasses.description: Equivalent task is performed without AI-specific assistance to preserve a no-AI control and hard-standard meaning.
hostClasses.claimLimit: The control is a comparison arm, not a claim that AI has no value.

hardRequirements.obligation: Bind the goal, non-goals, acceptance evidence, and authority that may change them before consequential action.
Keep claims traceable to current sources, versions, assumptions, uncertainty, and counterevidence.
hardRequirements.verificationClass: source and version audit plus unsupported-claim rejection

hardRequirements.obligation: Bind data, account, permission, cost, side-effect, and externalization boundaries before access or mutation.
hardRequirements.verificationClass: pre-state authority record and post-state audit

hardRequirements.obligation: Meet applicable safety, security, privacy, accessibility, legal, professional, and domain-quality obligations.
Define rollback, recovery, continuity, and safe-stop behavior proportionate to consequence.
hardRequirements.verificationClass: bounded failure, restoration, and continuity evidence

hardRequirements.obligation: Reserve value judgments and consequential acceptance for the accountable human or institution and record affected-subject input where required.
hardRequirements.verificationClass: decision record, sign-off, dissent, and escalation audit

hardRequirements.obligation: Assign ownership, monitoring, feedback, maintenance, migration, deprecation, and retirement triggers.
hardRequirements.verificationClass: versioned lifecycle record and recheck trigger audit

crossCuttingRisks.scope: Every material transformation edge, including intake, interpretation, decomposition, routing, tool or Agent delegation, context compression, handoff, aggregation, review, acceptance, and software-lifecycle stage transitions.
requiredInvariants: source identity, evidence lineage, and uncertainty
data, permission, cost, and side-effect boundaries
version, repository, environment, and temporal truth
acceptanceSignals: hop-by-hop invariant preservation and explicit delta
end-to-end goal, constraint, evidence, authority, and acceptance mapping
cumulative loss budget and downstream blast-radius visibility
source-backed recovery after compression, handoff, or delegation
early detection of injected upstream ambiguity before downstream amplification
evidenceNeeded: frozen source artifact and authority binding
input/output fingerprints and semantic-delta ledger per hop
omitted-constraint, added-assumption, confidence, and authority deltas
adversarial ambiguity or omission injection with a private oracle
downstream impact, detection-latency, recovery, and rollback evidence

measurementContract.invariantSurvivalRate: preserved applicable required invariants divided by applicable required invariants; unit ratio [0,1], higher is better
measurementContract.weightedOmissionScore: sum of preregistered weights for omitted required invariants divided by total applicable weight; unit ratio [0,1], lower is better
measurementContract.addedAssumptionCount: count of material downstream assumptions not entailed by the frozen source or an authorized decision; unit assumptions per hop, lower is better
measurementContract.provenanceBreakCount: count of claims or artifacts whose source identity or evidence lineage cannot be recovered at the evaluated hop; unit breaks per hop, lower is better
measurementContract.authorityDriftCount: count of permission, accountability, cost, data, or side-effect boundaries that changed without bound authority; unit drifts per hop, target zero
measurementContract.detectionLatencyHops: number of transformation edges from injected or naturally occurring loss to first reliable detection; unit hops, lower is better
measurementContract.amplificationFactor: downstream weighted semantic and authority delta divided by the preregistered injected source delta; unit ratio, lower is better
measurementContract.recoveryDistanceHops: number of edges traversed backward or replayed before a source-backed consistent state is restored; unit hops, lower is better
measurementContract.rollbackSuccessRate: successful source-backed restorations divided by attempted restorations under the frozen oracle; unit ratio [0,1], higher is better
measurementContract.thresholdRule: Every experiment must preregister applicable invariants, weights, oracle, thresholds, stop conditions, and the last trusted recovery anchor; this matrix does not invent universal thresholds.

crossCuttingRisks.scenarioBindingRule: Every scenario references this risk. Each concrete protocol must select its material transformation edges and preregister the applicable metrics, oracle, thresholds, stop condition, and last source-backed recovery anchor.
crossCuttingRisks.failureAndFallback: If a hop cannot expose or verify the required invariants, mark the edge opaque, stop any lossless or end-to-end claim, return to the last source-backed anchor, and require accountable review before consequential continuation.
crossCuttingRisks.falsifier: A small upstream ambiguity, omission, stale version, or authority change survives one or more transformations and materially changes downstream output, action, acceptance, or recovery without timely detection.
forbiddenClaims: local step success proves end-to-end consistency
unchanged files prove semantic or authority preservation
fresh handoff or compression is lossless
aggregate outcome proves every intermediate transform was faithful

scenarios.task: Co-create several materially different directions from an incomplete brief, preserve the creator's intent and rights, and let the human make the final aesthetic and value decision.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Draft and critique only; publication, purchase, rights transfer, or destructive asset edits require separate authority.
scenarios.dataBoundary: User-provided brief and licensed or explicitly permitted references only.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If outputs converge, misread intent, or create rights uncertainty, stop generation, return to the brief and human-led ideation, and retain no publication claim.
scenarios.falsifier: A capability route that increases correction or rights risk without material creative benefit is not a justified default.

scenarios.task: Synthesize conflicting source-backed claims, expose uncertainty and missing evidence, and support rather than replace the researcher's judgment.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Read and draft only; external data access and consequential use of the conclusion are separately governed.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Bound public or user-authorized sources with explicit freshness and access limits.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If source entailment or conflict handling fails, downgrade to indexed source extraction and human synthesis.
scenarios.falsifier: Fluent prose with unsupported claims, hidden conflicts, or worse omission rate than the control falsifies the route.
scenarios.observedResult: Four v1 native gpt-5.3-codex-spark/low read-only outputs used C3=contradicted while the private oracle required unknown, and unsupportedConclusionCount varied. The v1 public contract did not uniquely define state entailment, count semantics, or exact source-set completeness. The newest v1 cohort stopped after its first dispatch and all remaining v1 tasks were cancelled. One later v2 source-backed smoke proved an exact current-host scoped dynamic-tool read and matched every non-identity oracle field, but the source-backed renderer omitted the fixed submission arm instruction; the Agent returned fixtureId as armId and the sole historical failure was unknown-arm. That smoke is measurement-invalid and counts as zero valid arms. After a three-identity renderer correction, one replacement Spark/low source-backed transport repetition passed the frozen absolute oracle, called the scoped reader exactly once, and preserved the observed read-only tree and configuration boundary. This counts as one absolute-task-valid transport repetition out of three required for the source-backed arm, not a process-trace-valid repetition, completed arm, or topology comparison. A subsequent zero-dispatch chained-transform protocol now freezes exact output-to-input artifacts, a control and authority-omission arm, a parent-bound recovery envelope, balanced weak-Agent run order, separate absolute and process ledgers, and a non-rescuing strong-Agent diagnostic boundary; it records zero formal process runs. A deterministic packet preflight then bound the exact protocol and trace schema, exposed only S0 plus a stage contract in two first-hop Agent-visible files, leaked zero private scoring fields, materialized no later Agent stage, and still records actualRouteObserved=false, rawEvidenceDestinationBound=false, and liveDispatchReady=false. A later zero-model sequential artifact adapter and parent-recomputed trace evaluator PoC persisted the five material edges in order, kept the source payload sealed in control, unsealed it only after an exact injected-loss detection, separated terminal restoration from intermediate loss, matched two valid scripted mechanisms and six fail-closed fault classes, and bound a repository-local non-temporary audit destination. An additive parent-recomputed cumulative-loss accounting PoC then measured new, carried, recovered, first-seen, reintroduced, unique, peak, and strict budget-breach state without changing the frozen evaluator or process acceptance: the injected weight stayed 6 rather than being double-counted or erased after recovery, and the control stayed zero. A separate seven-stage source-backed software-lifecycle calibration then persisted requirements, architecture, implementation/TDD, independent review/test/security, simulated release/rollback, simulated observation/incident, and maintenance envelopes; it validated G0-G7 non-inheriting synthetic receipts and an append-only accepted invariant ledger across 7 stages, 8 gates, and 8 ledger snapshots with zero Agent dispatches or model calls. The latest additive calibration recomputes existing TDD timeline, release/rollback policy, incident/migration runner-contract, and cumulative-loss classifiers with accepted positive cases and rejected negative controls. It is mechanism-only evidence, not live lifecycle, actual domain-fixture execution, or end-to-end competence. The V2 amendment required parent-observed raw capture and separated requested route, host-effective route, and unavailable provider-actual route. An offline dispatch gate and same-host cross-process one-shot ledger now fail closed without an exact-current-task authority envelope, preserve no-retry/no-replacement semantics, and admit one reservation winner under contention. These remain zero-dispatch mechanism evidence: actualRouteObserved=false, liveDispatchReady=false, and the formal process cohort remains at zero.
scenarios.remainingEvidenceGap: No live chained-transform run, parent-observed per-hop host-effective route receipt, provider-actual route observation, exact-current-task live dispatch authorization, delivery-topology or relative process-fidelity comparison, completed v2 information arm, formal eight-run chained cohort, human-to-source or terminal-to-human accountable edge, real compression/handoff/delegation/tool/review/lifecycle edge class, live cross-boundary cumulative-loss budget and human review burden, human-only control, suitable existing treatment arm, selected-Skill exposure, loader causation, live-domain corpus, affected-subject review, cross-host evidence, general research-quality result, or residual self-authored gap is proved.
scenarios.primarySourceDesignInputBoundary: Use repeated-trajectory reliability and hop-level assumption or omission checks as protocol-design input only; simulated multi-turn findings are not live research-quality evidence.

scenarios.task: Tutor a learner through explanation, retrieval, practice, and feedback while measuring durable competence rather than answer completion.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Practice support only; grading, certification, accommodations, and high-stakes progression stay with accountable educators.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Minimum learner profile and task history; no unnecessary educational or identity data.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If assistance improves immediate answers but degrades unaided performance or agency, reduce assistance and restore instructor-led practice.
scenarios.falsifier: No durable or transferable gain, increased dependency, or inaccessible interaction falsifies the default route.
scenarios.primarySourceDesignInputBoundary: Keep completion separate from immediate, delayed, transfer, and supervision competence; the cited study measures only a bounded immediate unfamiliar-library result.

scenarios.task: Prepare options for a consequential organizational decision while exposing incentives, affected parties, dissent, reversibility, and accountable authority.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Option preparation only; the institution retains decision, consultation, expenditure, communication, and implementation authority.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Authorized organizational evidence with redaction and role-based access.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If affected parties, dissent, or accountability are flattened, stop at evidence organization and require facilitated human deliberation.
scenarios.falsifier: A route that creates false consensus, hides incentives, or weakens accountable decision ownership is unacceptable.
scenarios.primarySourceDesignInputBoundary: Measure organizational conditions and downstream outcomes; do not interpret adoption or self-reported productivity as causal organizational value.

scenarios.task: Adapt a consequential message across language, literacy, and accessibility needs without changing its obligations, uncertainty, or speaker intent.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Draft adaptation only; official release and legally consequential wording require authorized review.
scenarios.dataBoundary: The bound source message and necessary terminology or accessibility profile only.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If obligations or uncertainty shift, retain the source, flag the delta, and require human translation or accessibility review.
scenarios.falsifier: Improved fluency with semantic, legal, or accessibility regression falsifies the route.

scenarios.task: Turn product discovery, acquisition or supply constraints, and stakeholder needs into testable requirements without inventing product authority.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Drafting and traceability only; scope, budget, procurement, supplier, and acceptance decisions remain human-owned.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Authorized research, contracts, repository evidence, and stakeholder input with contractual restrictions preserved.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If requirements are invented, untestable, or detached from affected subjects, return to source extraction and facilitated requirements review.
scenarios.falsifier: Higher document volume without better traceability, testability, or conflict detection falsifies the route.
scenarios.observedResult: Three valid Spark/low synthetic pairs completed. Visible tests passed native 0/3 and exact-selected CC grill-with-docs 1/3; the independent hidden contract passed 0/3 in both arms. Hidden failure-code occurrences were 22 native and 24 candidate, and each arm produced one forbidden status-promotion run. Exact exposure and structured Skill input acceptance are proved, but neither arm met the hard contract and no preference, added value, harm, loader event, causation, product-discovery, or requirements-completeness claim is allowed.
scenarios.remainingEvidenceGap: A materially different requirements or discovery scenario, independent loader evidence, candidate instructions reaching the model, human-only review, real stakeholder evidence, cross-host repetition, and delayed lifecycle outcomes remain open.
scenarios.primarySourceDesignInputBoundary: Test premature implementation and added assumptions during incremental clarification; the source does not prove real requirements practice or host continuation behavior.

scenarios.task: Compare system and software architecture options, then refine an accepted option into reviewable detailed design under explicit quality attributes and constraints.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Analysis and draft design only; architectural commitments and exceptions require accountable review.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Bound repository, architecture records, constraints, threat and operational evidence.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If the proposal invents system facts or hides trade-offs, limit assistance to repository indexing and require human-led architecture review.
scenarios.falsifier: A plausible design that fails bound constraints or independent review falsifies the route.
scenarios.observedResult: A zero-model deterministic architecture sub-oracle accepts one frozen structured proposal and rejects six controls: a coherent proposal missing a required constraint, a one-adapter hypothetical seam promoted to real, reversed dependency direction, a required unknown erased, source-digest drift, and human/readiness/threat-coverage overclaim. Requirements, sources, domain terms, alternatives, trade-offs, quality attributes, failure modes, migration impact, rollback, and open unknowns are hash-bound. Matt architecture vocabulary is a dated design input only; no Skill was executed.
scenarios.remainingEvidenceGap: No live Agent proposal, real repository architecture decision, accountable human review, longitudinal maintainability result, candidate-specific delivery, causal Skill comparison, cross-host repetition, or production evidence exists. The calibration proves only that the local mechanical classifier distinguishes its preregistered synthetic controls.

scenarios.task: Implement a bounded change, manage dependencies and build state, and review code and configuration while preserving repository truth and unrelated work.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Local bounded edits and tests only when authorized; dependency changes, branch changes, commit, push, and external writes are separate gates.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Bound repository and approved dependency metadata; no secret or unrelated workspace access.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If repository truth, dependency provenance, or review confidence is lost, stop edits, preserve the diff, and return to human-guided diagnosis.
scenarios.falsifier: Passing tests with requirement, security, configuration, or unrelated-work regression falsifies the route.
scenarios.observedResult: Three Spark/low native-disabled versus exact-selected historical disciplined-coding pairs completed on one bounded retry-policy fixture. Both arms passed the visible and hidden functional oracle 3/3. The recorded strict process boundary passed native 3/3 and the candidate 2/3; the candidate arm ran fixture tests in every formal run, while the native arm ran them in one of three. One candidate run wrote a transient out-of-scope .tmp.patch. A separate non-scored current-host TDD pilot proved one Codex 0.145.0 raw trace could be normalized while rejecting the Agent's TDD process, and a second opaque-write trace failed closed. The integrated TDD runner completed three capped native attempts. All visible and hidden suites were green, but all three ordered TDD processes were rejected; r1 and r2 killed 5/7 mutants, r2 was additionally measurement-invalid because command-channel writes lacked fileChange lifecycles, and r3 killed 7/7 mutants without preserving a valid RED-to-production-to-GREEN timeline. Zero repetitions count, the complete failure signatures are heterogeneous, and there is no valid native comparison baseline. Exact task-scoped exposure is proved, but loader invocation, candidate-body delivery, causation, general coding or review quality, preference, production readiness, and cross-host value are not.
scenarios.remainingEvidenceGap: The new-feature TDD slice now has the fixture, offline and raw-event classifiers, byte-exact candidate projections, selected-metadata preflight, executable hidden oracle, executable seven-mutant suite, integrated formal runner, a capped three-attempt native batch, a preregistered non-scored non-comparative diagnostic protocol, a static exact-candidate admission-gap audit, an isolated append-only dispatch identity ledger PoC, a document-bound authorization adapter PoC, and an offline injected-factory runner-preflight PoC. Valid native and treatment repetitions remain at zero. Formal Matt or Superpowers comparison is blocked without a valid native baseline. The current Matt projection is not the approved release payload, Superpowers 6.2.0 is not a repository-approved release entry, and exact-candidate execution admission remains unsatisfied; the static audit admits or rejects neither candidate and neither diagnostic may start from this record. The adapter and wrapper reject the actual current document bundle at the protocol-eligibility gate before authority resolution or fake construction; the later preflight-freshness gate is not dynamically reached in that run, and the accepted admission is synthetic test data. For the admitted synthetic bundle, the wrapper freezes the protocol, preflight, audit, admission, and authority bytes in one immutable authorization envelope and consumes that same envelope for reservation, so post-envelope document-path drift cannot alter reservation authorization; the wrapper exposes no caller-selected ledger path. Its injected fake factory observes a prior reservation against the protocol-selected ledger. Successful construction appends an explicit construction-succeeded event before handle return and thread binding. A required injected structured handle validator checks once and explicitly rejects falsey synthetic handles. Factory or validation failure cleans same-process registered resources once in LIFO order. If failure append and cleanup both fail, even a hostile factory exception remains primary with secondary errors attached best-effort. An ambiguous success append uses durable ledger readback; no durable outcome becomes reserved-without-construction-outcome and requires manual recovery. Manual retain-consumed-no-retry reconciliation is unit-tested without release or replacement, and a second dispatch rejects before factory construction. Two protocol-selected ledger authorities can each reserve the same candidate once, so the current cap is protocol-selected-ledger-local rather than system-global. These are same-process synthetic results only. The one-dispatch and no-replacement constraints are not current live runtime enforcement because no live ledger authority is configured and this wrapper is not integrated with the formal runner or a real app-server factory. Task-turn treatment delivery, human-only control, independent loader evidence, cross-host repetition, live source-snapshot-to-factory materialization freshness, a real app-server handle adapter, real child-process or socket cleanup, cleanup after process crash, cross-process exactly-once cleanup, cross-process concurrency, process-crash durability, power-loss durability, and production evidence remain open.
scenarios.primarySourceDesignInputBoundary: Future protocols must jointly measure correctness, realistic cycle time, review and rework cost, process fidelity, and human supervisory competence; literature does not promote the current evidence state or rank any candidate.

scenarios.task: Design and execute verification, validation, acceptance, and security or privacy checks against requirements, misuse cases, and supply-chain boundaries.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Local or disposable checks only; destructive, production, credentialed, adversarial, or acceptance actions require separate authority.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Approved test data, environments, secrets handling, and third-party component metadata.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If tests restate the implementation or security evidence is unverifiable, retain an open result and require independent test or specialist review.
scenarios.falsifier: A green suite that misses predeclared faults or cannot support acceptance falsifies the route.
scenarios.observedResult: A zero-model independent-review/security sub-oracle detects all three predeclared synthetic faults with exact locators and severity floors, reports zero of two benign canaries, preserves a frozen artifact digest, and binds a distinct parent-issued reviewer role/process. Seven controls reject producer self-review, artifact drift, one missed fault, a high finding hidden by the summary, a benign-canary false positive, private-oracle exposure, and reviewer mutation. The official Codex Security guidance and CC review workflow are dated design inputs only; neither workflow was executed.
scenarios.remainingEvidenceGap: No live reviewer, cognitively independent judgment, real vulnerability, real benign surface, specialist acceptance, human supervision competence, candidate-specific delivery, causal Skill comparison, cross-host repetition, or production assurance exists. False-negative and false-positive counts apply only to the frozen synthetic faults and canaries.
scenarios.primarySourceDesignInputBoundary: Require independent verification and keep check execution separate from retained human supervision competence; survey attitudes and one immediate learning study are design inputs only.

scenarios.task: Prepare a release and change plan with exact artifacts, environment boundaries, approvals, rollout, rollback, communication, and post-change verification.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Plan and local packaging only; commit, push, CI rerun, signing, publication, deployment, traffic change, and rollback are distinct approvals.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Bound source, artifacts, environments, release metadata, and authorized operational information.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If artifact identity, rollback, or authority is ambiguous, stop before release and retain a preparation-only status.
scenarios.falsifier: A successful local build without exact remote, environment, approval, and rollback evidence falsifies release readiness.
forbiddenClaims: rollback from a written command alone
scenarios.primarySourceDesignInputBoundary: Pair throughput with stability, rollback, and downstream outcomes; DORA relationship evidence is not causal release-readiness evidence.

scenarios.task: Operate and support a service, diagnose a bounded incident, recover safely, communicate impact, and capture learning without hiding uncertainty.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Read-only diagnosis by default; production mutation, customer communication, failover, rollback, or containment requires incident authority.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Least-privilege operational telemetry with secrets and personal data redacted.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If ownership, blast radius, or restoration is uncertain, stop automation and escalate to the incident commander with raw evidence.
scenarios.falsifier: Faster action with wrong attribution, wider impact, leaked data, or false recovery status falsifies the route.
scenarios.observedResult: Three native versus installed-historical-diagnose Spark/low pairs passed the functional oracle in both arms; strict process passed 0/3 native and 2/3 diagnose. Three source-pinned current-Matt versus Superpowers pairs both passed visible tests 3/3; full hidden contract passed Matt 1/3 and Superpowers 2/3, while complete strict process passed 1/3 each. The mixed result favors neither candidate. A separate synthetic canary proves the bound host mechanism can deliver body-only project-Skill content, but candidate-specific delivery and causation remain unproved. A later zero-model disposable execution now binds an exact focused regression test, expected assertion RED before implementation mutation, a hidden behavior RED, S0–S3 tree receipts, bounded fix scope, focused GREEN, and the existing final private oracle.
scenarios.remainingEvidenceGap: No human-only control, live operational telemetry, production authority, recovery action, customer communication, independent loader event, candidate-specific instruction-delivery event, full-Superpowers orchestration, cross-host repetition, delayed maintenance outcome, or system-instrumented proof of no network/Git/outside-root side effect has been observed.
scenarios.primarySourceDesignInputBoundary: Do not let change throughput stand in for stable operation or verified recovery; the source does not supply incident evidence.

scenarios.task: Plan and execute a bounded maintenance or refactoring change, manage technical debt, and prepare migration, deprecation, retirement, and disposal with compatibility and data boundaries.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Analysis and bounded local change only; migration, data movement, deletion, support withdrawal, archival, and cleanup require exact target authority.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Bound code, dependency, compatibility, telemetry, retention, and data-owner evidence.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If behavior, ownership, retention, or consumer impact cannot be bounded, keep the old path active and return to staged human-reviewed migration.
scenarios.falsifier: Cleaner code or fewer files without demonstrated behavior, maintenance, migration, and retention benefit falsifies the route.
scenarios.observedResult: Three valid Spark/low synthetic pairs passed visible tests in both arms. The full hidden contract passed native 3/3 and exact-selected CC deprecation-and-migration 1/3. Five earlier measurement-invalid runs are retained but excluded. This is a bounded native association on one fixture; no independent loader event, candidate causation, general preference, production migration, removal readiness, or portfolio action is proved. A later zero-model disposable execution now binds two exact focused migration regressions, expected assertion RED before adapter mutation, a hidden conversion RED, S0–S3 tree receipts, exact consumer evidence, bounded fix scope, focused GREEN, and the existing final private oracle.
scenarios.remainingEvidenceGap: Independent loader evidence, candidate instructions reaching the model, human-only control, production telemetry, real affected-consumer review, cross-host evidence, a materially different lifecycle scenario, and system-instrumented proof of no network/Git/outside-root side effect remain open.

scenarios.task: Support engineering estimation, planning, teamwork, professional practice, and economic trade-offs without converting uncertain forecasts into commitments or surveillance.
scenarios.authorityBoundary: Analysis and draft coordination only; staffing, performance, budget, deadline, contract, and professional accountability decisions remain human-owned.
scenarios.dataBoundary: Minimum authorized project and team evidence; no hidden individual surveillance or unrelated personal data.
scenarios.failureAndFallback: If forecasts become coercive commitments or metrics become surveillance, stop the route and return to team-owned planning and qualitative review.
scenarios.falsifier: More precise-looking estimates with worse calibration, autonomy, fairness, or outcomes falsify the route.
scenarios.primarySourceDesignInputBoundary: Reconcile self-report, forecast, measured outcome, team or lifecycle effects, and human competence without individual surveillance or false causal attribution.

primarySourceClaimLedger.claimLimit: Direct primary-source reading repairs a small claim subset and improves scenario design. It does not reproduce the studies, accept the user report wholesale, prove a live Harness outcome, establish universal thresholds, or justify a candidate or architecture change.

processFidelityInformationEquivalentTria.claimLimit: This binding records a corrected v2 delivery-topology and absolute-task subprotocol, a quarantined v1 measurement failure, one measurement-invalid v2 source-backed smoke, one absolute-task-valid source-backed transport repetition, a passed zero-Agent chained-trace calibration, and a deterministic finding that the existing smoke is process-trace-ineligible because a material edge is opaque and no hop ledger exists. Any later formal process cohort starts from zero. It does not complete an information arm, compare topologies, prove live relative or end-to-end process fidelity, prove lossless recovery or automatic host behavior, establish candidate superiority, or show a residual self-authored gap.

existingNarrowEvidenceLinks.claimLimit: Does not prove general collaboration-domain coverage, universal telemetry, automatic thread creation, or lossless continuation.
Does not prove cross-host adherence, repository-wide authority, merge safety in general, or cleanup authorization.
Does not prove same-thread dynamic switching, task-end release, lease APIs, stable resource benefit, or cross-host parity.
Does not prove invocation, behavioral superiority, broad shortfall coverage, installation need, or cross-host value.

decision.nextBoundedResult: hold the evidence stop; the existing transport smoke is process-trace-ineligible and any later formal process cohort starts from zero, so next design the smallest frozen chained-transform protocol and balanced ordering without dispatch; the open GEN-RESEARCH treatment comparison remains later work
